شَانِفٌ Turning away, or averse. (O, K.) One says, مَا لِى أَرَاكَ شَانِفًا عَنِّى What ails me that I see thee turning away, or averse, from me? (O.) ―
-b2- And إِنَّهُ لَشَانِفٌ عَنَّا بِأَنْفِهِ (tropical:) Verily he is raising his nose [in aversion] from us. (O, * K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
